claim: Uber Boat by Thames Clippers runs river-bus services Putney to Barking Riverside seven days a week, with a hop-on hop-off River Roamer day pass passing Big Ben, Tate Modern, the Shard and Tower Bridge.
quote: Hop-on Hop-off ticket is an unlimited all-day ticket to travel across all piers between Putney and Barking Riverside

claim: Top Sunday roast bookings in London include The Harwood Arms (the only Michelin-starred pub, releases tables 90 days ahead), The Marksman in Hackney, Blacklock, Quality Chop House, and The Red Lion & Sun — all need booking weeks ahead.
quote: The Harwood Arms in Fulham is London's only Michelin-starred pub... Bookings release 90 days in advance and disappear quickly

claim: Free outdoor cinema in the window includes Summer Screens at Canary Wharf (4 June-1 Sep, films/Wimbledon/cricket on Canada Square Park's big screen) and Lower Marsh Lates (Cool Runnings 25 June, free entry).
quote: Free screenings run from 4 June-1 September 2026... Summer Screens at Canary Wharf... coverage of Wimbledon and cricket fixtures

claim: London's free Royal Parks — Hyde Park, Regent's Park (with Queen Mary's Rose Gardens at peak in June), Greenwich Park (Royal Observatory and skyline view), Richmond Park (deer), and St James's Park — are all open and ideal for sunny-day picnics.
quote: London's best parks include Hyde Park, Regent's Park, Hampstead Heath, Greenwich Park, Richmond Park, and Victoria Park — all free to enter

claim: The Spring Bank Holiday Monday is 25 May 2026, falling immediately before the trip start; carry-over openings into 29 May include Somerset House's 'Holy Pop!' exhibition and London Rivers Week's 10th anniversary programme.
quote: Somerset House's "Holy Pop!" exhibition explores the power of fandom through art, memorabilia, letters, photographs, and interactive installations
